scope: Capability audit of external representations in the inherited 132-component catalog and accepted storage, knowledge and PDF additions; not a function-complete API inventory.
basis: selected CMake sources and compile definitions
retained primary public headers and source documentation
reading_rule: direction describes compiled capability; header_instantiation and retained_source_only are explicit exceptions. Read/write are not symmetric unless actual APIs and selected build support both.
application_boundary: LMX owns application data semantics. YAML/TOML/INI are only foreign-file compatibility when an external consumer requires them. Database/medium formats are lower I/O layers, not a proposed extra object/settings architecture.

cJSON numbers use double; do not silently route arbitrary integers or exact decimal values through double.
Jansson exposes distinct integer/real values; available range still depends on its compiled types.
rows.verification: Source/header/CMake audit; no new comprehensive format-conformance test suite executed for this matrix.

rows.verification: Source/header/CMake audit; no new comprehensive format-conformance test suite executed for this matrix.

gaps.status: PDFio parses objects, metadata and decoded streams and copies pages. General page rendering and text extraction with reading-order reconstruction are not provided.
ZIP/XML can extract package parts, but DOCX/ODT/PPTX/ODS semantic readers/renderers are not provided by those low-level codecs.
MAT4/5 are included. HDF5 and all netCDF profiles are excluded by explicit selection decisions; MAT7.3, NumPy NPY/NPZ and DICOM are not established by a verified target in this matrix.
No selected AVIF/HEIF/JPEG XL/OpenEXR/SVG renderer identified. TIFF codec coverage is explicitly profile-limited.
No general MP4/MOV reader/writer, HEVC/AV1/VP9 codec, AAC/Opus codec, or MP3/FLAC/Vorbis encoder identified; nestegg only demuxes.
No selected RAR/BZip2/XZ-container codec; selected LZMA SDK cannot create 7z archives.
No dedicated CSV/TSV parser/writer target identified; correct quote/newline rules would need a small explicit adapter.
Mint native-converted model is not direct ONNX reading; GGUF/SafeTensors import is not established.
FASTA/FASTQ macro parser and BGZF exist; complete SAM/BAM/CRAM/VCF semantics are not implied.
